memory: I see that Michael has ordered the Steam-Based Espresso System with a stainless-steel finish. The order was placed with the intention of using the steam wand for frothing milk and creating coffeehouse-style beverages. The machine is designed to be sleek and modern, fitting comfortably in Michael's available space. The dimensions of the machine are 18 inches wide, 12 inches deep, and 20 inches tall. Michael is concerned about the delayed delivery and lack of updates. I will need to check the order status and provide an update to Michael.
